title: Practice the pawn's first move.
goal: Move your pawn from the square e2 to the square e4 in one move.
narration_seed: Pawns move forward and can take a longer first step.
hints: A pawn may move two squares forward on its first move when the path is clear.
solution_text: Move your pawn from the square e2 to the square e4.
success_text: You advanced your pawn to the square e4.
failure_text: Try moving the pawn straight forward from the square e2.
